rebuttal_or_critique: With headline CPI at 7.01% and core inflation at 6.20% persistently above our tolerance band, the risk of unanchored inflation expectations is the primary threat to medium-term growth. The system liquidity surplus of 190,000 crore INR and a positive output gap of 0.40% confirm that the banking system has ample room to absorb a 50 bps hike. I maintain that front-loading is essential to preserve our institutional credibility; failure to act decisively now would only necessitate a higher terminal rate later, which would be more detrimental to the growth recovery. I am aligned with the emerging majority consensus for a 50 bps increase.
